openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The ZyXEL WSM20 ("Multy M1") is an AX1800 AP or WiFi extender with 4 gigabit ethernet ports. There are 2 separate internal PCB antennas. It's designed to create a ZyXEL Wifi Mesh by using multiple Multy nodes.
openwrt_wiki.Serial_text: A 3.3V TTL UART with 4 pins. Pinout from left to right: [o] TX (green) [o] RX (white) [o] GND (black)
openwrt_wiki.Installation_web: hidden local firmware upgrade page http://192.168.212.1/gui/#/main/debug/firmwareupgrade; dual firmware, initramfs first, then sysupgrade; factory reset first if red LED on
openwrt_wiki.Installation_uart: boot loader has no timeout; failsafe in stock, mount_root, fw_setenv bootmenu_delay 3, U-Boot menu flashes initramfs
openwrt_wiki.LED_beim_flashen: red flashing ~1/s ~10 s, then green steady, then white fast/slow flashing, white steady = OpenWrt installed
